Protections | Technical
 Procedure
Introduction
This
document outlines the testing procedure P1, which must be performed on an
annually basses as indicated by Y1 in the above title block
The
first draft is initiated by eng. Mohamed Aly Aly Hassan tested by eng. Al shahat Ahmed Mousa at 03 Sep. 2003,
revised by EDEPC quality control engineer Adel Al-nagar,
accepted by general director eng. Hamdy Abdel Mawla Meligy,
and approved by eng. Yousry Mohamed Aly Salama Head Sector of Elshabab GT Power
Station
The
Protection Scheme consist of:
Differential
 protection Relay { F 305 }
Over
 current protection Relay { F 307 }
Single
 phase over current Relay { F4 }
High
 Impedance
 Relay 
 { F5 }
Over
 current protection Relay { F1 }
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and
the qualified maintenance stuff should be carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution
marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear your safety helmet, safety
shoes . etc.
Step down transformer off ( low
 and high side ).
All mcc (Motor 
 Control Center) CB out service.
Isolate side protection must be done as follows:
(A) Differential protection relay { F305 Type ( D 202 ) } .
No. 3 , 7 ,
11 High side
No. 2 , 6 ,
10 Low side
(B) Over current protection relay { F307 Type ( ITX 192 232 ) }.
No. 1 , 3 , 5
 Low side transformer
(C) Single phase over current relay { F4 Type ( ISM2) }
No. 70 , 71
(D) High Impedance protection
relay { F5 Type IM 21 qv+ YB1 L 21 }
No. 76 , 75
(E) Over current protection relay { F1 Type ( RSZ 3f1 ) }
No. 7 , 8 , 9
Tools and Equipment
Sverker test set.
Air blower.
Complete maintenance set.
Cleaning power ( 90 ) (
 Video cleaner dry 90 ).
Work to be Carried Out
Connect the relay testing units (
 Sverker ) to a power source .
Connect the timer to power source and its terminals
 to the trip terminals the relay test.
Put an ammeter on current leads of testing unit to
 measure the current and connect the volt meter in parallel with the
 voltage leads testing unit to measure the voltage.
Review the manual .
Prepare the previous results of the relay testing .
Be sure that the CB unit and the transformer are
 disconnected and DC source is available .
Differential Relay F 305 type 
D202
Inject 0.3Amp. to operating coil to terminals ( 3 ,
 1 ) , ( 7 , 1) , (11,1) 66KV Side.
Record Results.
Inject 1 Amp. to operating coil to terminals ( 2 , 5
 ) , (6,5) , (10,5)
Record results .
Over Current Relay 
F307 type ITX 192 - 232
Inject 1.1 Amp. To
 operating coil to terminal (1,2 ) , ( 3, 4) , (5,
 6) the operating coil working after 1.1 sec.
Record results for s.c
 current.
Inject 7 Amp. to operating
 coil to terminals ( 1,2 ) , ( 3,4) , ( 5,6 ) the operating coil 
 working.
Record Results.
Single Phase Over current Relay 
 ISM2
Inject 1.0 Amp. to operating coil to terminal ( 70, 71 ) the operating coil working after 1sec.
Record results .
High
Impedance Relay IM 21qv + YB1 L21
Inject
 62 volt AC to operating coil to terminals ( 75 ,
 76 ).
Record
 Results .
Over Current Relay F1 type RS 3 F1
Inject
 5.0 Amp. to operating coil to terminals No
 ( 7,10 ), ( 8,11 ) , (9,12 ) the operating coil working after 1.1 sec.
Record results.
Putting the Protection Relay
into Service
Check
 that the CT and PT secondary connection as before the test
Close
